candidates: When forwarding any optional property from `options.angularBuilderOptions` into `builderOptions` in `framework-preset-angular-cli.ts`, always guard the assignment with an `!== undefined` check (e.g. `if (options.angularBuilderOptions?.prop !== undefined) { builderOptions.prop = options.angularBuilderOptions.prop; }`). The builder options object is populated via a prior deep-merge of the Angular browser target, so an unconditional optional-chain assignment (`builderOptions.prop = options.angularBuilderOptions?.prop`) will overwrite an already-merged default with `undefined` whenever the caller omits that option.
